messages:
ana (finance): Heads-up: we're piloting a new billing feature called Buffered Charge Shield (BCS). Purpose: reduce one-off overages by letting short bursts be covered by a small buffer and by presenting a clearer invoice line for redistributed burst usage. Pilot opt-in starts 2025-11-18; GA target 2025-12-20.

ben (product): In plain language for customers? What will they see differently?

ana (finance): Typo — ana here. For customers: fewer surprise emails about hitting a soft quota. Invoices will include a new column `buffer_adjustment` showing when burst was absorbed or redistributed. Also changing credits: promotional/trial credits move to a 120-day flexible redemption window (same aggregate value). Existing accounts get a 30-day grace where the old rules still apply.

kira (eng-runtime): Implementation note: enforcement is at the request-router. We'll tag burst-consumption with `bcs_pool` and emit metrics `bcs_used` and `bcs_available`. New export fields: "buffer_tokens", "buffer_action" (absorbed|redistributed|none). Canary rollout Nov 12, region rollouts Nov 15-18.

omar (support): Need: short FAQ, canned replies, example invoice CSVs, and sample webhook payloads. Also a support playbook for Dedicated customers who want a fixed buffer amount.

legal-bot: Contracts: add a short addendum clarifying BCS is a billing presentation/aggregation mechanism; not a price increase. Offer 30-day opt-out for active enterprise SLAs.

ops-bot: Internal announcement email scheduled 2025-11-11 16:30 UTC; console banner scheduled 2025-11-12.

omar (support): Can we get sample invoice snippet for the new view?

kira (eng-runtime): Example (illustrative):
INVOICE LINE: route=chat/short | usage_tokens=9,120 | buffer_tokens=300 | buffer_action=absorbed | line_cost=$45.60

ben (product): Marketing and Support: please draft a 1-pager and a customer-friendly changelog blurb by Nov 9 so we can align external comms.

ana (finance): Pilot perks: redistributed buffer usage will be waived for eligible early-stage customers during pilot. Finance will track weekly impact and report to the billing review. DM me for pilot nominations. :sparkles:
